result.description: Agentic document platform that parses, extracts, splits, classifies and edits PDFs, spreadsheets, images and office files into structured data via API.
result.auth_detail: API key created in Reducto Studio, sent as Authorization: Bearer header. OAuth device-code flow exists only for CLI/MCP login, which just obtains an API key. No third-party OAuth app flow.
result.access_detail: Anyone can sign up at studio.reducto.ai and create an API key. Standard plan is pay-as-you-go and includes free starter credits (pricing page: $150 / 15,000 free credits). Growth and Enterprise are contact-sales but not needed.
result.api_notes: REST endpoints: /parse, /extract, /split, /classify, /edit, plus async variants and GET /job/{job_id}, upload, and webhooks. OpenAPI schema is published. Python/Node SDKs and a CLI exist. Focused on document processing, so the surface is a few dozen endpoints.

evidence.quote: Add this block to your MCP client config and replace `your-api-key` with a key from [studio.reducto.ai/api-keys](https://studio.reducto.ai/api-keys):
Create an API key in Reducto Studio (https://studio.reducto.ai) under API Keys.
Sign up for a free account without leaving the docs.
Pay-as-you-go per-product pricing with 15,000 free credits
Pull specific fields from documents into structured JSON using a schema.
Async endpoints return a `job_id` immediately and process in the background.
The Reducto MCP server connects AI agents directly to Reducto.
Reducto turns PDFs, spreadsheets, images, and office files into structured data.
